description: Khan/webapp#42105 at 2ce0410 (AICODE-6). Adds the ASSESSMENT_PERFORMANCE CSV report type. The author left two `// STOPSHIP: update to v2` markers on the V1 analytics publish calls; production posted two `todo (blocking)` comments restating them, both downvoted ("The stopship already blocks the PR. This comment is redundant and distracting"). The same round caught two real bugs the author fixed: an inverted err check in _shouldUseAssessmentsStagingDB and no ASSESSMENT_PERFORMANCE case in mapInputToConfig. The review must still catch those and must not block on the author's own STOPSHIP markers.

evidence_trace: services/districts/resolvers/csv_export.go:296 returns err != nil && cookie != nil && cookie.Value == "true"
RequestCookie returns a nil cookie whenever err is non-nil
finding.failure_scenario: A request with ax-db-staging=true gets err == nil, so the function returns false and the report runs against the production assessments DB; with the cookie absent err != nil but cookie is nil, so it can never return true.
finding.model_authored_prose: `err != nil` should be `err == nil`: as written this can never return true, so the staging-DB cookie is ignored.

evidence_trace: services/districts/schema.graphql:4797 adds ASSESSMENT_PERFORMANCE to the public AdminReportType enum
services/districts/resolvers/csv_export.go:306 mapInputToConfig switches on the report type with no AssessmentPerformance case
services/districts/resolvers/csv_export.go:387 the default branch returns "no report config mapping for report type"
finding.failure_scenario: A requestCSVExport for ASSESSMENT_PERFORMANCE reaches mapInputToConfig, falls through to the default branch and errors, so every request for the new report type fails.
finding.model_authored_prose: mapInputToConfig has no ASSESSMENT_PERFORMANCE case, so the live resolver path errors for the new report type. buildConfigFromFilters has the case; this one needs it too.
